aggregation.triggerCorrelation: group by exact headSha and createdAt
aggregation.workflowFanOut: maximum distinct workflowId per correlated trigger
aggregation.billedMinutes: nearest-rank p95 of per-trigger sum of ceil(non-skipped job duration seconds / 60), minimum one minute per started job
aggregation.queueTimeSeconds: nearest-rank p95 of run createdAt to job startedAt
aggregation.p50Seconds: nearest-rank p50 of run startedAt to run updatedAt
aggregation.p95Seconds: nearest-rank p95 of run startedAt to run updatedAt
